how_to_apply: Open the official SMC website between 16 November 2026 (11:00 AM) and 30 November 2026 (11:00 PM). Study the detailed advertisement PDF of the cadre you want.

Complete User Registration: enter e-mail address, mobile number and captcha; verify the OTP sent to the mobile; enter first name, last name and a password; then verify the e-mail through the link received. Registration alone does not confirm the application.
Log in and fill the User Profile with name, date of birth and Aadhaar details as on the proof documents, address, and languages known. Click Apply Now against the cadre.

Fill Personal Details (including dependent of municipal employee or SMC employee details if applicable), Educational Qualification, Experience Details (institution, dates, designation, nature of work, monthly salary) and Documents Details. Tick the documents you will produce.

Enter the system-generated code and answer the declaration. Upload the photograph (up to 150 KB, 5 cm height by 3.6 cm width) and the signature (up to 50 KB, 2.5 cm height by 7.5 cm width) in JPG/JPEG or PNG; sign on white paper in black or blue.
Check the preview, then click Confirm & Pay. Pay the fee online, and download and print the payment receipt. The receipt is also sent to the e-mail address given.
To correct a form before final submission, use My Application(s) on the Home tab, select Edit Application or Upload Photo And Signature, then Confirm & Pay again.

content_sections.heading: About SMC
content_sections.text: Surat Municipal Corporation is the civic body of Surat, Gujarat. Its office is at Shri Tapi Bhavan, Gordhandas Chokhawala Marg, Tapipura, Surat. The notice is signed by the Deputy Municipal Commissioner (D), and recruitment queries go to its Central Establishment (Recruitment) Department.

content_sections.heading: SMC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 123 posts across three cadres, but online applications are invited for 70 of them, the first two rows. The 53 Assistant Engineer (Electrical) posts appear only because their number was corrected. The notice prints a roster (category) table for each cadre covering SC, ST, SEBC, unreserved and EWS posts, with a women column in each. Please see the official notification for that break-up. Divyang (PwD) reservation: Deputy Town Planner 1 post; Assistant Town Planner 2 posts. Only candidates with the disabilities listed against a post can apply for its reserved posts.

content_sections.heading: SMC Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Experience: at least five years of work related to Town Planning after obtaining the qualification. Computer knowledge: the basic knowledge of Computer Application prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules 1967, as amended from time to time. Language: adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Experience: the notice prints no experience requirement for this post. Computer knowledge: the same Rules 1967 standard as above. Language: adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Experience is counted only if gained after obtaining the qualification, and it must be shown with an experience certificate. An offer letter or appointment letter is not accepted as proof of experience. Candidates who passed the CCC or CCC+ examination (or an equivalent degree approved by the Government), or who were trained by SMC, must submit the certificate. The notice refers to passing within one year of appointment. SC, ST, SEBC and EWS posts are counted only for candidates of those categories who are originally from Gujarat. Reserved-category candidates may apply for unreserved posts, but then the unreserved selection standards apply. SMC regular employees need not meet the age limit; SMC trainees on a fixed monthly stipend are subject to the age rules. Candidates should read the official notification for the exact eligibility rules of each post.

rows.qualification_required: M.Arch./M.E.(Civil)/B.Arch./B.E.(Civil)/M.Plan/B.Plan from any recognized university, and a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma course in City Planning/Town Planning/Regional Planning from any recognized institute, or membership of the Institute of Town Planners after passing its examination.
The same degree and Post Graduate Degree/Diploma (or Town Planners' institute membership) as for Deputy Town Planner.

content_sections.heading: SMC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: SMC will prepare a waiting list of candidates who meet the prescribed qualification, to fill the currently vacant posts by direct recruitment. Considering the number of applications received, the Municipal Commissioner will decide whether written, practical or oral interview stages are held; his decision is final. The final selection list and waiting list are prepared on the decisions of the Staff Selection Committee under the recruitment rules for each cadre. Candidates attend any test at the place fixed by the Appointment Authority at their own cost; SMC pays no travel expense. If candidates have equal merit, the older candidate gets priority; if age is also equal, educational merit decides.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of age: birth certificate, school leaving certificate or secondary or higher secondary certificate (any one). Educational qualification: mark sheets, degree certificate, attempt certificates and registration certificate; a grade-to-percentage conversion certificate of the university where marks are given in grades. Experience certificate on the institution's letterhead with signature and date, showing nature of work and basic and total pay. SC or ST candidates: caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Gujarat Government. SEBC candidates: Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Gujarati format of Annexure-4, valid for the financial year and the next three, issued on or after 01-04-2024 and not after the last date. An English Annexure-A certificate is not accepted. EWS candidates: eligibility certificate in the Gujarati format (Annexure-G) issued by the Government of Gujarat, valid for three years and issued by the last date. PwD candidates: disability certificate and UDID (Unique Disability Identity Card). Married women: marriage registration certificate or Government Gazette copy to apply under the husband's name. Candidates in government, semi-government or company service: No Objection Certificate; training or service details; EPIC, PAN card and Aadhaar copies. Originals and one attested copy are submitted at document verification, not at the time of applying.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are invited for 70 posts: 14 Deputy Town Planner and 56 Assistant Town Planner.

faq.question: Q2. When do applications start for SMC Deputy and Assistant Town Planner?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, up to 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for the unreserved category and Rs. 400 for reserved categories (all women, SEBC, EWS, SC, ST) and PwD candidates, paid online and not refundable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Deputy Town Planner: not more than 45 years. Assistant Town Planner: not more than 35 years. Age is counted on 30 November 2026, with relaxation for reserved-category Gujarat candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: M.Arch./M.E.(Civil)/B.Arch./B.E.(Civil)/M.Plan/B.Plan, plus a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in City, Town or Regional Planning or Town Planners' institute membership. Deputy Town Planner also needs five years' Town Planning experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Deputy Town Planner is on Level-9 (Pay Matrix Rs. 53100-167800) and Assistant Town Planner on Level-8 (Rs. 44900-142400).

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: SMC prepares a waiting list. The Municipal Commissioner decides, after seeing the number of applications, on written, practical or oral interview stages.

faq.question: Q9. I applied under the March 2026 advertisement PRO 739. Do I apply again?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who already applied for Deputy Town Planner or Assistant Town Planner under that advertisement need not apply again.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for Assistant Engineer (Electrical)?
faq.answer: No application is invited for it in this notice. Only the number of posts, 53, was corrected.
